component.name: S226 Heart Rate
component.summary: Live heart rate and step cadence from the S226 watch

description.p: Shows the heart rate measured by an S226 (H-Band / Veepoo) fitness watch as a large number that fills the window, together with today's step count and the current walking cadence in steps per minute.

ul.li: Optional metronome that clicks along with the heart rate
Graph of heart rate and cadence over 1 minute to 2 hours
Every reading is logged to a daily CSV file

description.p: The app talks to a USB Bluetooth controller directly over raw HCI instead of going through BlueZ, so it needs read/write access to the controller's USB device node.
First version of the graphical heart-rate app.
